notes.notes:

Hear ye, friends of Post Human W.A.R!

It's been eight weeks already since the release of Post Human W.A.R, and many battles have taken place! New ways of taking advantage of our game mechanics have been found and spread! Today we're launching the first post-release update. This is kind of an important update, with two major novelties:
[list]
    [*]The ability to create games with 3 or 4 players, online or offline. You can compete in teams or in a free-for-all. And if you're a local co-op aficionado you can also challenge the AI! And to celebrate, three new maps will allow you to have 4 players.
    [*]Also, the introduction of Post Human W.A.R Steam Cards! You asked for them, it is now done.[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new features! May the strategy be with you.

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Final Patch Note 21 - ONE LAST TIME, WITH FEELING
notes.notes:
Hi there, fellow strategists!

Okay, here we are, the final update! Next week, Post Human W.A.R will be out of its early access, meaning that all the missions of the campaign mode will be available... but we'll talk about it next week :-)

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]

So for this final Patch Note, we're glad to announce that we have [b]implemented the daily challenges[/b]! It's gonna be Groundhog Day everyday, but with a twist - every day will have a new challenge - and Postcoins for those who succeed. You'll be able to purchase a lot of avatars and units skins with the Postcoins, so be sure to come back everyday! Oh, and you'll also be able to [b]unlock new Pourparlers[/b] (you know, these nice and friendly emojis you can send to your opponent).
Second and last point, we made some [b]balancing in a few campaign mode battles[/b]. We don't want you to be frustrated in one way or another, especially if you are a sore loser.

WHEW, I guess we're done for the Post Human W.A.R Patch Notes. I'm pretty sure you'll miss these almost-weekly updates, but the true adventure begins now for us. Help us spread the word about Post Human W.A.R release, and how our game is a must-have for all turn-based strategy fans! And if you wanna hear some good dev stories or just talk about the game, [url=store.steampowered.com]make sure to join us on our Discord thread! [/url]


See you on the other side, my friends!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/63dae1d356e35c9b15b8c8dd5143a4b9e02a80ad.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Full release spotted! Post Human W.A.R is out of early access December 14th!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

The long-awaited news is here: Post Human W.A.R will fully release in 2 weeks!

Next week, we'll give you news about the final update.

CHEERS!

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 18
notes.notes:
He who craves outsmarting moves, may he be welcome!

Here's another Patch Note for Post Human W.A.R. We are currently in our final stretch, and the full release is pretty close. We'll be sure to give you informations about it pretty soon. But for now, here we go for the Patch Note #18!

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 16
notes.notes:
- Hey, Mike. Wake up Mike. Mike! MIKE WAKE UP FOR F*CK SAKE!
- Ralph? W-W-W-What's going on? It's like 2 in the morning! And how did you get in my house? Ugh, forget it. I gotta sleep, got a lot of things to do tomorrow!
- OH PLEASE! I know Saturday is laundry day for you... You'll also grab a few expired food at the grocery store - yes, I know you buy expired food because you're POOR - and send a pathetic text message to your pathetic ex-girlfriend, just to tell her how miserable your life is now, but she'll probably ignore it because she's too busy GETTIN' LAI--
- OK, OK, I GET IT. You don't need to be so rude... So what do you want ?
- What do I want? What do I want? I want to show you this beauty. It's a time travelling machine called Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 16!
- ... Post Human what? I'm sure I'm gonna regret it but... What is it?

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]

- Okay, listen up Mike. This is no ordinary time travelling machine. With this one, you can now record every game you played in Post Human W.A.R - training mode, local versus, online, or whatever.
- Yeah, okay. Time travelling machine. Cool. Can you leave now?
- That's not all, you dumb*ss. With this machine, you can also watch your previous games, and skip the waiting time of all actions. You can even skip directly to the turn you wish to watch, if you have something particular in mind! 
- That's... yeah that's great Ralph, really. Okay, well, thanks for showin--
- NOT. DONE. YET.
- Jeez...
- Let's say you have a friend. Yeah I know, pretty unrealistic because except me, you have no friend.
- Right now, you're more like a bed intruder than a friend to me.
- LET ME FINISH. So, this hypothetical friend do not believe you when you say you have accomplished a wonderful action. Well, now, you can export your game and share it to your him. Or even the world. Or EVEN THE UNIVERSE. Can you believe it? The U.N.I.V.E.R.S.E.
- I don't think the universe cares about it, but ok, that's good to know. Anything else?

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R is evolving!
notes.notes:
What? Post Human W.A.R is evolving! 
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]
Our game is undergoing an important gameplay mutation to expand its psychological impact: killing the opposing Champion is now an immediate win condition.

Picture a game of chess where any piece could be the King, and you have to deduce which one it is.

At the beginning of each battle, the players form their armies and each selects one secret unit to be their Champion. The first player to kill the opposing Champion wins the game. You’re free to pick any frail or strong, flying or ground, melee or ranged unit, as well as either keeping it safe, behind your lines or exposed on the front line to trick the enemy… Craft your own plan and strategize your battle! You’ll have to read your enemy’s moves and bluffs to find the Champion and get rid of him... before he gets yours!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/05c7be44b181254e049afd90f1b12d84d3ebba4b.gif[/img]

These changes allow the game to become truly strategic and psychological. The outcome of every skirmish still matters as it allows you to get the upper hand and weaken the enemy’s lines. 

To balance things out, we also introduce a Revelation mechanic! All players can uncloak their Champion, whenever they wish. In return, the revealed Champion gains a powerful stat boost. A truly double-edged sword move! This risky bet will make the Champion the priority target, but can also help you turn the tables in times of need. Use it wisely! 

We sincerely hope that you will like the direction Post Human WAR is taking and are waiting for your feedbacks!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]
Our game is undergoing an important gameplay mutation to expand its psychological impact: killing the opposing Champion is now an immediate win condition.

Picture a game of chess where any piece could be the King, and you have to deduce which one it is.

At the beginning of each battle, the players form their armies and each selects one secret unit to be their Champion. The first player to kill the opposing Champion wins the game. You’re free to pick any frail or strong, flying or ground, melee or ranged unit, as well as either keeping it safe, behind your lines or exposed on the front line to trick the enemy… Craft your own plan and strategize your battle! You’ll have to read your enemy’s moves and bluffs to find the Champion and get rid of him... before he gets yours!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/05c7be44b181254e049afd90f1b12d84d3ebba4b.gif[/img]

These changes allow the game to become truly strategic and psychological. The outcome of every skirmish still matters as it allows you to get the upper hand and weaken the enemy’s lines. 

To balance things out, we also introduce a Revelation mechanic! All players can uncloak their Champion, whenever they wish. In return, the revealed Champion gains a powerful stat boost. A truly double-edged sword move! This risky bet will make the Champion the priority target, but can also help you turn the tables in times of need. Use it wisely! 

We sincerely hope that you will like the direction Post Human WAR is taking and are waiting for your feedbacks!

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Early Access Prolongation
notes.notes:
Hello to all post-humans!

First of all, thank you for these two months of Early Access, during which your feedback has greatly helped us to improve the game.

We are very happy about it, but also facing this: Currently multiplayer isn’t really used, since there is not enough people to match opponents quickly, and the user experience is compromised. In order to not let this side of Post Human W.A.R sink into oblivion, we decided to make important changes to smooth the multiplayer modes and give a new interest to the game. This will allow us to have a better communication, to attract more players, and get the ball rolling. We are still cooking up the surprise; simply know that the champion system is likely to grow in importance...

The direct consequence of these changes is that it will take a little time to set them up. The release of the game will therefore be around september. We apologize for the extra delay, but it is for the good of the game, and we will still have regular updates throughout the summer.
Until then, do not hesitate to play in multiplayer!

Again thank you everybody, and good battles.

Another week, another Patch Note! Post-Human W.A.R updates are moving smoothly, and today's patch note is quite light. But don't fret, we're rampin' up for next week's menu!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]

Anyway, here's today's dishes:

- New FX added
- New sound effects for units
- A better focus on ennemy units when they act
- And as usual, a few bugs fixes

[i]Bon appétit[/i], and see you next week!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/a65183c212cc51cb8cfa37bcea51b831f284d5eb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note #2
notes.notes:
Hello, dear strategists!

Here's the second patch note, so keep your eyes peeled!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]

- You don't give a damn about the Human legacy? Well, rejoice, because the first 3 missions of the Wraak faction have been added!
- [i] Vous aime le France[/i] ? I bet you do. The French voices have been implemented to the R-Patch video introduction. [i]Bravo![/i] 
- Some matchmaking tweeks: in Conquest Mode, when 2 players are looking for a game with different resource points set, they might be put together - based on the lowest one - to speed up game search.

And among other stuff:
- A fullscreen / windowed mode button on the splash screen
- New visuals in the campaign mode menu
- Lastly, we have corrected a few bugs. This is Early Access after all.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/ef94dbf483f4cf50cd0e4fc13b047da850de956b.jpg[/img]

That's all folks. Don't hesitate to share your feedback if you like Post Human W.A.R (or not).

[i]Le bisou.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Note #1
notes.notes:
Hi there, fellow Post Human W.A.Rriors. 

Here we are, the first Early Access Update. Yaaaay!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/13c221d7aada90cc9aa7f25f5f89333f150a40ed.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png[/img][/url]

- First of all, our game is getting a little more international, since we added 2 new languages : Russian and Spanish. Did I hear a "Harasho"? Or was that a "Fantástico"?
- We also heard that numerous players got their asses handed to them in the mission 2 of the R-Patch Campaign. We lowered the difficulty (a little bit).
- Some server issues have been detected. The scum has been eliminated and you should be able to reconnect to your battle without losing the game now.
- Cleaned out a few bugs (AI being stuck in campaign mode, spectator mode...)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/20b97db855f6128e329a7d986b86a3bdf10c3720.jpg[/img]

And that's it for today. Talk to you next week.

Class Dismissed!
